unsupported.name: Add_Job_Intervals
native_signatures: procedure Add_Job_Intervals (Object : in out Job; Intervals : RX_Job_Interval_List)
unsupported.reason: no unique supported source/native presentation equivalence
unsupported.source_signature:
--  Synchronously serialize current safe values through native contract version 16, including mixed RX/TX. Historical v1-v15 contracts retain frozen layouts/domains: v16 uses the v8 base, TX-v3 and modulation-v5 plus context, not interchangeable array strides. Full-batch structural validation and local copied-value preparation precede one unlocked provider Add, including empty batches. Ordered intervals/events and duplicates survive. Borrowed transient Ada/C backing lasts through the call; native values own copies (native buffer copies share fresh sample vectors). Invalid final configuration raises Constraint Error before provider Add; lifecycle, registration and provider failures raise Provider Error. Add requires an open Job before any Finalize/full Cancel attempt, even if that attempt failed. Enabled reporting requires usable prior registration; no delivery guarantee. Externally serialize all same-Job calls/Close. No automatic retry: provider may mutate before throwing, and normal void return proves neither scheduling nor event execution/RF emission. Snapshot remains unchanged.
   --  @param Object Open Job with Add admission still available.
   --  @param Intervals Complete owned ordered batch; not consumed by submission.

   procedure Add_Job_Intervals (Object : in out Job; Intervals : RX_Job_Interval_List)
   renames Add_RX_Job_Intervals;

unsupported.name: Complex_I16
unsupported.reason: no unique supported source/native presentation equivalence
unsupported.source_signature:
--  Copy all counters under the native callback-state lock without consuming products. Every
   --  counter saturates; queue-full drops are distinct from malformed products and allocation
   --  failures. Closed/invalid native ownership raises Provider Error.
   --  @param Object Open endpoint whose bridge counters are sampled.
   --  @return Independent diagnostic counter snapshot.

   type Complex_I16 is record
      Real : Interfaces.Integer_16;
      Imag : Interfaces.Integer_16;
   end record
   --  C-compatible Cartesian I/Q value with two signed 16-bit integer components. Native
   --  MELComplex values are copied component-wise; no upstream C++ object-layout compatibility,
   --  sample scaling or normalization is assumed.
   --  @field Real Signed real (in-phase) component, copied without DSP conversion.
   --  @field Imag Signed imaginary (quadrature) component, copied without DSP conversion.
   with Convention => C;

unsupported.name: Complex_I8
unsupported.reason: no unique supported source/native presentation equivalence
unsupported.source_signature:
--  C-convention array of signed 16-bit Cartesian pairs; Length counts pairs, not bytes.
   --  Borrowed nonempty sample arrays use indices 0 through count minus one; explicit copies use 1
   --  through count. Empty arrays have a null range.

   type Complex_I8 is record
      Real : Interfaces.Integer_8;
      Imag : Interfaces.Integer_8;
   end record
   --  C-compatible Cartesian I/Q value with two signed 8-bit integer components. Native MELComplex
   --  values are copied component-wise; no upstream C++ object-layout compatibility, sample
   --  scaling or normalization is assumed.
   --  @field Real Signed real (in-phase) component, copied without DSP conversion.
   --  @field Imag Signed imaginary (quadrature) component, copied without DSP conversion.
   with Convention => C;
